title: EvidentialStateSnapshot
description: The computed evidential state of ONE relation at a query time under a profile. It describes REGISTERED evidence under one profile and time; it is NOT a declaration of domain truth. The state is derived from which supporting/refuting evidence bases are admissible at `queryTime` (and optional `observerTime`), never from a copied relation-level interval.

relationId.description: The relation whose state is reported.

profileId.description: The grounding profile under which state was computed.

supportingEvidenceIds.description: Identifiers of admissible supporting evidence bases at the query time.

refutingEvidenceIds.description: Identifiers of admissible refuting evidence bases at the query time.

observerTime.description: Optional observer time for bitemporal evaluation.

excludedEvidence.description: Evidence bases considered but excluded (e.g. inadmissible at the query time), with reasons.

policyId.description: Optional admission policy relevant to interpreting the snapshot.

computedAt.description: When the snapshot was computed (record time).
